gloss: apparent temperature; wind chill; feels-like temperature

definitions.gloss: apparent temperature; how hot or cold it feels
definitions.explanation: The temperature a person actually feels, as opposed to the thermometer reading. Wind lowers it and humidity raises it; weather forecasts often give it alongside the air temperature.

examples.japanese: {体感温度|たいかんおんど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧。
⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{体感温度|たいかんおんど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{下|さ}がる→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧。
examples.english: A strong wind makes it feel colder.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{気温|きおん}→気温：00235_kion⟧⟦こそ→こそ：12731_koso⟧{十度|じゅうど}だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{体感温度|たいかんおんど}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{零度|れいど}→零度：27531_reido⟧{近|ちか}く⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧そうだ。
examples.english: The air temperature today is ten degrees, but they say it will feel close to zero.

notes:
⟦{体感|たいかん}→体感：33195_taikan⟧ (bodily sensation) + ⟦{温度|おんど}→温度：00333_ondo⟧ (temperature).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {体感温度|たいかんおんど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{下|さ}がる→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧ / ⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧: it feels colder / hotter
- {体感温度|たいかんおんど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧ / ⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧: it feels cold / hot
- {体感温度|たいかんおんど}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧: the feels-like temperature is so many degrees

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{気温|きおん}→気温：00235_kion⟧: air temperature, the measured figure
- {体感温度|たいかんおんど}: what the body feels; in winter it is close to English "wind chill", in summer to "heat index"
